CreditLatch.audience: Bookkeeping and controller firms reviewing wholesale-client exports.
CreditLatch.summary: CreditLatch checks payment and supplier-credit CSV exports for potential overpayments and unmatched credits, with source rows and review packets. The scanner runs in the browser; flagged amounts are not proof of money owed or recovered cash.
CreditLatch.valueEvent: A source-linked exception review packet that a bookkeeper can verify with a client

DeleteRail.tagline: Own the code behind privacy-request processing.
DeleteRail.audience: Privacy and engineering teams at data brokers.
DeleteRail.summary: DeleteRail focuses on customer-owned privacy-request processing: retrieve request lists, match records, route review-gated actions and retain status evidence. The implementation is designed for the customer's cloud; designated reviewers retain legal and production decisions.
DeleteRail.valueEvent: A tested, customer-owned request-processing workflow with review controls and traceable results
